task.description: Validate test design: OIDC-F-01 and OIDC-F-02 (MUST) have runnable E2E tests, no test.skip, real Keycloak used, each verdict is visual. PASS or FAIL.

result.summary: Test design validated for OIDC-F-01 through OIDC-F-04. All 6 checks passed.

checks.must_coverage_oidc_f01: PASS - TC-OIDCF-01 and TC-OIDCF-02 both cover OIDC-F-01
checks.must_coverage_oidc_f02: PASS - TC-OIDCF-03 and TC-OIDCF-04 both cover OIDC-F-02
checks.no_test_skip_on_must: PASS - No test.skip or test.only on any MUST test case
checks.no_mock_auth_exchange: PASS - page.route() used only to abort outgoing redirect to Keycloak /auth endpoint; token endpoint and /auth/callback are not intercepted
checks.real_keycloak_tc03: PASS - TC-OIDCF-03 uses performOidcLogin() with no mocking; connects to real Keycloak at localhost:8081
checks.error_path_test_exists: PASS - TC-OIDCF-04 navigates to /auth/callback?error=access_denied and verifies login-auth-error banner on /login?reason=auth-error
checks.screenshots: PASS - All 5 test cases take at least one screenshot after key actions via shot() helper
